Patient: Jose Hernandez, age 38.

- Grimacing
- Tachycardia (HR 104) - pain response
- Elevated BP (142/88) - pain response
- Hematuria on urinalysis
- 38-year-old male

This is a classic presentation of a ureteral stone causing renal colic.

- Pacing (can't stay still - classic for renal colic)
- Grimacing
- Tachycardic
- Hypertensive
- Vomiting
- Unable to sit still
